name: Zain's Blog
overview: This website: a record of my competitive programming practice, with a problem archive, a verified activity log, quizzes and a roadmap towards a 1800 Codeforces rating.
problem: Keeping an honest, searchable record of practice, including problems not yet solved, without editing it by hand after every session.
decisions: A static site with no backend or tracking: everything is built ahead of time and hosted on GitHub Pages.
The activity log is rebuilt from the commit history of the solutions repository every six hours by a GitHub Actions workflow, so each entry is traceable to a commit.
Problem names, ratings and tags come from Codeforces' public API; statuses come only from the log.
Quiz questions are checked by compiling and running the real solution before they can be approved.

name: comp-program-grind
overview: My C++ solutions to Codeforces problems, one file per problem, many with my notes at the top.
decisions: Commit messages record what happened with each problem (solved, attempted, redo), which is what this site's activity log reads.
